name: IAM Add User to Group
description: An attacker with iam:AddUserToGroup can add a user (themselves or a backdoor user) to an IAM group that has elevated permissions. Group membership grants the user all permissions attached to the group's policies. If the attacker finds a group with broad access (e.g., AdminGroup), adding their user immediately escalates privileges. Required permission is iam:AddUserToGroup. The attacker must have a user to add and the group must exist.
detectionStrategy: AddUserToGroup is dangerous because group membership instantly grants all permissions attached to the group. The best detections focus on privileged groups (Admin, PowerUser, break-glass), suspicious target users (backdoor patterns, self-addition), and follow-on privileged activity by the added user.
